title: End-to-End VM Build for App Onboarding

scenes.line1: How do you build a secure VM?
scenes.say: Ever wonder what it really takes to build an app-ready virtual machine, on-prem or in Azure? Let's break down the steps you can't miss.

Here’s the flow: reserve your IP and DNS, build from a golden image using infrastructure as code, join your domain, set up time sync, configure disks, harden the OS, add agents, assign patch groups, set up service accounts, deploy your app, lock down the firewall, and validate everything.

scenes.title: Build a VM with CLI
scenes.say: In Azure, you use the command line to create your resource group and VM, then run Ansible playbooks for hardening, agents, and app setup. On-prem? Clone from a template, then run the same playbooks.

scenes.question: What's often missed in onboarding?
scenes.right: Validation—always check app health and ports after setup. Don’t just assume it works.
scenes.say: A common trap? Skipping validation. Always check your app’s health and open ports before you call it done.
